// Journal entries can now contain rich text (bold/italic/etc, stored as HTML) instead of plain
// text. These helpers keep every OTHER part of the app (search, crisis detection, index
// snippets) working against plain text regardless, since raw HTML tags mixed into a substring
// search or a keyword scan would silently degrade both -- and for crisis detection specifically,
// a degraded scan is a real safety concern, not just a cosmetic one.
function stripHtmlTags(html){
  if(!html) return '';
  var tmp = document.createElement('div');
  tmp.innerHTML = html;
  return tmp.textContent || '';
}
function looksLikeHtml(text){
  return /<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(text || '');
}
// Entries saved before rich text existed are plain text and may contain characters like < or >
// that would be misread as real HTML tags if set directly as innerHTML (losing content, or
// worse, rendering something unintended) -- this escapes those before display, and converts
// plain newlines to <br> so old entries still look the same as they always did.
function plainTextToSafeHtml(text){
  var div = document.createElement('div');
  div.textContent = text || '';
  return div.innerHTML.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
}

function commitMainJournalIfDirty(){
  var textEl = document.getElementById('journalText');
  var text = textEl.value;
  if(!selected.length && !text.trim()) return false;

  if(editingEntryRef){
    // Editing an existing entry in place, not creating a new one. Sharing status is left
    // untouched here on purpose -- editing the text shouldn't silently change whether it's
    // shared with a therapist. That's now only ever changed via the explicit Share button on a
    // saved entry, never during composition/editing.
    var entry = editingEntryRef;
    entry.moods = selected.map(function(b){ return {label:b.label, color:b.base}; });
    entry.text = text;
    saveState();
    if(entry.id){
      sb.from('entries').update({
        moods: entry.moods, text: entry.text || ''
      }).eq('id', entry.id).then(function(){});
    } else {
      // This entry was never actually synced in the first place (from before this whole class
      // of bug was fixed) -- treat editing it as the moment to finally save it for real.
      saveEntryToSupabase(entry);
    }
    logAnalyticsEvent('journal_edited');
    maybeShowCrisisResources(text);
    return true;
  }

  var entry = {
    date: new Date().toISOString(),
    moods: selected.map(function(b){ return {label:b.label, color:b.base}; }),
    text: text,
    sharedWithTherapist: false // sharing only ever happens after publishing now, via the explicit Share button on a saved entry
  };
  appState.entries.unshift(entry);
  saveState();
  saveEntryToSupabase(entry);
  trackNotificationAction(selected.length ? 'logged_mood' : 'wrote_journal_entry');
  logAnalyticsEvent(selected.length ? 'mood_logged' : 'journal_written');
  maybeShowCrisisResources(text);
  return true;
}
```

NEW (exact):
```
function commitMainJournalIfDirty(){
  var textEl = document.getElementById('journalText');
  var text = textEl.innerHTML; // rich content, what actually gets saved and displayed
  var plainText = textEl.textContent; // plain text, for the emptiness check and crisis detection only
  if(!selected.length && !plainText.trim()) return false;

  if(editingEntryRef){
    // Editing an existing entry in place, not creating a new one. Sharing status is left
    // untouched here on purpose -- editing the text shouldn't silently change whether it's
    // shared with a therapist. That's now only ever changed via the explicit Share button on a
    // saved entry, never during composition/editing.
    var entry = editingEntryRef;
    entry.moods = selected.map(function(b){ return {label:b.label, color:b.base}; });
    entry.text = text;
    saveState();
    if(entry.id){
      sb.from('entries').update({
        moods: entry.moods, text: entry.text || ''
      }).eq('id', entry.id).then(function(){});
    } else {
      // This entry was never actually synced in the first place (from before this whole class
      // of bug was fixed) -- treat editing it as the moment to finally save it for real.
      saveEntryToSupabase(entry);
    }
    logAnalyticsEvent('journal_edited');
    maybeShowCrisisResources(plainText);
    return true;
  }

  var entry = {
    date: new Date().toISOString(),
    moods: selected.map(function(b){ return {label:b.label, color:b.base}; }),
    text: text,
    sharedWithTherapist: false // sharing only ever happens after publishing now, via the explicit Share button on a saved entry
  };
  appState.entries.unshift(entry);
  saveState();
  saveEntryToSupabase(entry);
  trackNotificationAction(selected.length ? 'logged_mood' : 'wrote_journal_entry');
  logAnalyticsEvent(selected.length ? 'mood_logged' : 'journal_written');
  maybeShowCrisisResources(plainText);
  return true;
}
```

(function(){
  var journalTextEl = document.getElementById('journalText');
  var simpleCmds = { fmtBoldBtn:'bold', fmtItalicBtn:'italic', fmtStrikeBtn:'strikeThrough', fmtUnderlineBtn:'underline' };
  Object.keys(simpleCmds).forEach(function(btnId){
    document.getElementById(btnId).onclick = function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      journalTextEl.focus();
      document.execCommand(simpleCmds[btnId], false, null);
      refreshToolbarState();
    };
  });
  document.getElementById('fmtHeadingBtn').onclick = function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    journalTextEl.focus();
    var sel = window.getSelection();
    var node = sel.anchorNode;
    var inHeading = false;
    while(node && node !== journalTextEl){
      if(node.nodeType === 1 && node.tagName === 'H2'){ inHeading = true; break; }
      node = node.parentNode;
    }
    document.execCommand('formatBlock', false, inHeading ? 'P' : 'H2');
    refreshToolbarState();
  };
  function refreshToolbarState(){
    try {
      document.getElementById('fmtBoldBtn').classList.toggle('active', document.queryCommandState('bold'));
      document.getElementById('fmtItalicBtn').classList.toggle('active', document.queryCommandState('italic'));
      document.getElementById('fmtStrikeBtn').classList.toggle('active', document.queryCommandState('strikeThrough'));
      document.getElementById('fmtUnderlineBtn').classList.toggle('active', document.queryCommandState('underline'));
      var sel = window.getSelection();
      var node = sel.anchorNode, inHeading = false;
      while(node && node !== journalTextEl){
        if(node.nodeType === 1 && node.tagName === 'H2'){ inHeading = true; break; }
        node = node.parentNode;
      }
      document.getElementById('fmtHeadingBtn').classList.toggle('active', inHeading);
    } catch(err) { /* queryCommandState can throw in rare states -- not worth breaking the toolbar over */ }
  }
  document.addEventListener('selectionchange', function(){
    if(document.activeElement === journalTextEl) refreshToolbarState();
  });
})();
document.getElementById('expandBtn').onclick = function(){

function looksLikeHtml(text){
  return /<[a-z][\s\S]*>/i.test(text || '');
}
// Alignment is saved as an outer wrapper div (see commitMainJournalIfDirty) since it lives on
// the container's style, not in the rich content itself -- this extracts both pieces back out
// when loading an entry for editing.
function unwrapAlignedEntry(html){
  var m = /^<div style="text-align:\s*(left|center|right|justify)\s*">([\s\S]*)<\/div>$/i.exec((html||'').trim());
  if(m) return { align: m[1], inner: m[2] };
  return { align: 'left', inner: html };
}
```

# HOBS Companion — Master Project State (v19)
**Last updated:** August 2, 2026

---

## 1. What This Project Is

HOBS Companion is the mobile app for **Home of Beautiful Souls Foundation**, a survivor-led mental health NGO in Ahmedabad, India, founded by Akash Ramchandani in March 2020. The app combines journaling, mood tracking, task management, therapy booking, and donations into one Capacitor-wrapped web app for Android, backed by Supabase.

**Core philosophy baked into the design:** low cognitive load, no shame-inducing UI (no red "overdue" flags), gentle language, and features that work *with* how people navigating mental health difficulty actually engage with a screen — not generic productivity-app patterns.

---

## 2. Architecture

### Stack
- **Client:** Single-file vanilla JavaScript app (`index.html`, ~950KB), wrapped in Capacitor for Android. No framework — all UI is built and updated via direct DOM manipulation.
- **Hosting:** GitHub Pages (`homeofbeautifulsouls-sys.github.io/hobs-companion-app`). Auto-deploys on push to `main`. HTML is gzip-compressed automatically by GitHub Pages (935KB raw → ~225KB transferred). **Known platform limitation:** GitHub Pages fixes image cache-control at `max-age=600` (10 min) with no override — repeat app opens re-download unchanged images. Fixable only by migrating hosting (not done).
- **Backend:** Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Storage + Edge Functions + pg_cron).
- **Payments:** Razorpay (Checkout + Orders API + Webhooks).
- **CRM:** HubSpot (portal `242408729`) — used for both donation/booking form submissions and screening test results.
- **Notifications:** Firebase Cloud Messaging via Capacitor Push plugin + Supabase Edge Functions on a cron schedule.

### Repo layout
- `index.html` — the entire app (all panels, all logic)
- `donate.html` — standalone public donation page (also embeds in-app)
- `delete-account.html`, `privacy-policy.html`, `terms-of-service.html` — standalone legal/utility pages
- `supabase/functions/` — all Edge Functions
- `android-native-assets/` — files that must be manually reapplied on every native APK rebuild (see §7)

### Key Supabase tables
`profiles`, `entries` (journal), `tasks`/`subtasks`, `donations`, `donation_campaigns`, `expert_bookings`, `test_results`, `notification_log`/`notification_recipients`, `app_releases`

---

## 3. Complete Feature Inventory

### Journal
- Mood-bubble picker (physics-based floating bubbles, organic scatter layout)
- Free-text entry with **rich text formatting** (added Aug 2, 2026): H1/H2/H3 headings, Bold, Italic, Strikethrough, Underline, and whole-entry alignment (left/center/right/justify)
- Voice-to-text via `transcribe-audio` Edge Function
- Book-index style entry list (dotted leader lines, "Title .......... Date")
- Edit/archive/share-with-therapist per entry
- Crisis detection: instant local keyword check + background AI check (`check-journal-risk` Edge Function) — **currently inactive**, see §6
- Separate lightweight "Quick Journal" flow (plain text, no formatting) for fast mood-only captures

### Tasklist
- Priority-zoned list with drag-to-reorder, subtask breakdown, image thumbnails, partial-completion tracking
- Calendar/day-view integration
- **Not yet built:** a redesigned "constellation" concept (3D, star-based, tap-to-focus) — prototyped and tested, not integrated. See `/mnt/user-data/outputs/tasklist_constellation.html` and memory for full spec.

### Therapy Booking
- Three-role architecture: Client / Therapist / Admin, single Supabase backend
- Booking calendar with Paytm QR (being replaced by Razorpay — see below)
- Session notes, therapist homework, cancellation-charge flow
- Client can request a time; therapist accepts/changes/rejects

### Payments (Razorpay) — built this session
- **Donations** (web `donate.html` + in-app): real Checkout, order created server-side via `create-razorpay-order`
- **Session payments**: admin sets `amount_due` on a booking (no fixed price — sliding scale), client pays that exact amount
- **Cancellation charges**: same pattern — admin sets `cancellation_amount_due`, client pays via a "Pay Now" that appears once set
- **Security model:** amount is *never* accepted from the client for bookings/cancellations — always looked up server-side. Client-side "success" is never trusted; only `razorpay-webhook`, after independently verifying Razorpay's HMAC-SHA256 signature, marks anything as paid.
- **Performance:** script prefetch + parallelized order-creation, keep-warm cron (`keep-warm-razorpay-order`, every 4 min) to avoid Edge Function cold starts, real loading overlay
- **UPI:** not code-controlled — must be enabled in Razorpay Dashboard → Account & Settings → Payment Methods, or via Razorpay Support

### Donations
- Campaign system (`donation_campaigns`), admin-managed, one active campaign shown at a time
- Profile widget: prefetched at sign-in, renders instantly (no loading gap) — fixed Aug 2, 2026
- **Dedicated test campaign** for all future testing: id `0a0f501b-2359-430a-be0d-223f678a6451`, title `__CLAUDE_TEST_CAMPAIGN_DO_NOT_USE__` — never toggle Akash's real campaigns for testing (see §5, real incident)

### Notifications
- Recurring: journal reminder, mood check, task reminders, book-session nudge — via `notification-scheduler` (pg_cron, every 15 min)
- One-off: admin manual, app-update, booking confirmations — via `send-push-notification`
- Support group polls via Bob mascot — `send-group-poll`
- Delivery relies on Android notification channel (fixed in v2.9) + explicit local-notification fallback for foreground/backgrounded states (fixed Jul 31, 2026 — see §5)

### Admin Dashboard
- Donation campaign management, booking payment/payout management, user/profile management, therapist dashboard

### Website (homeofbeautifulsouls.com)
- WordPress/Elementor, separate from the app. SEO work, corporate mental-health page, screening reports, GSC integration — see prior session history in memory (not touched this session).

### Screening Tests
- 16 test types, HubSpot auto-sync via DB trigger → `sync-test-result-to-hubspot`, submits through the same HubSpot **Form** the website uses (not the CRM Notes API — see §5 for why this matters)

---

## 4. Pipelines

### Notification pipeline
`pg_cron (every 15 min)` → `notification-scheduler` Edge Function → checks each user's local time against reminder windows → `notification_log` + `notification_recipients` rows → FCM send → client `pushNotificationReceived` listener → explicit local notification post (guaranteed, not dependent on Android's own background auto-display)

### Payment pipeline (donation example)
Client taps Pay → `openRazorpayPayment()` (parallel: load Razorpay script + call `create-razorpay-order`) → Edge Function validates campaign/booking server-side, creates real Razorpay Order, inserts unconfirmed `donations`/`expert_bookings` row → client opens Razorpay Checkout with that order_id → **on actual payment**, Razorpay calls `razorpay-webhook` directly (server-to-server) → webhook verifies HMAC signature → marks the row `payment_confirmed: true`

### Crisis detection pipeline
Journal save → `maybeShowCrisisResources(plainText)` (HTML stripped first) → instant local keyword check (`containsSelfHarmSignal`) → if clear, background call to `check-journal-risk` Edge Function (AI-based, catches indirect/metaphorical language) → shows crisis resource modal if either check fires. **Currently the AI check is inactive** — see §6.

### HubSpot sync pipeline (screening tests)
Test completed → DB trigger `test_results_hubspot_sync` → `sync-test-result-to-hubspot` Edge Function → submits via HubSpot Forms API (portal `242408729`, form `5fd53be3-ca4a-4850-ba4d-840574af6ae3`) — same form the website uses, so it triggers the same automated follow-up workflow and appears under Forms → Submissions (not Contacts → Notes, which was the original, wrong implementation — see §5)

---

## 5. Bugs Found and Fixed (this session, July 31 – August 2, 2026)

Each of these was found through direct testing (Playwright, real browser, real data) rather than assumed fixed — several were caught specifically *because* something was tested rather than trusted.

1. **HubSpot sync went to the wrong place.** Used CRM Notes API instead of the website's own Form submission — meant no automated email fired and results didn't show under Forms. Fixed by switching to the actual Form endpoint. Found and fixed a second real bug *while testing the first fix*: HubSpot's Forms API hard-rejects submissions with no phone number (10 of 21 users had none on file) — fixed with a graceful placeholder.

2. **Notification delivery silently broken for backgrounded/killed app states.** A July 21 fix for a genuine duplicate-notification bug removed the JS-side guarantee of posting a local notification, making delivery depend entirely on Android's native auto-display. If that failed (e.g., a missing notification channel — separately fixed in v2.9), notifications vanished with nothing to catch it. Restored an explicit, deduplicated local-notification post for every reachable app state.

3. **App load time: 12.45s → 7.50s** on a throttled connection. Root cause: several images loaded eagerly and were absurdly oversized for their display size (`logo.png` was 1024×495px shown at 80px wide). Resized/recompressed all startup images (PNG→JPEG where transparency wasn't actually used, confirmed via alpha-channel inspection), added `loading="lazy"` to all 37 `<img>` tags except the two needed immediately.

4. **Razorpay checkout felt slow (1–2s delay).** `openRazorpayPayment` loaded the Checkout script and created the order sequentially instead of in parallel. Parallelized + added prefetch at the three entry points. Separately found the Edge Function itself had a real cold-start penalty (2.09s cold vs 0.5s warm) — fixed with a keep-warm cron ping every 4 minutes, using a dedicated zero-side-effect `purpose:"ping"` mode.

5. **Real incident: Akash's actual donation campaign kept getting deactivated.** Root cause was Claude's own testing methodology — reusing his live campaign for Razorpay tests and "cleaning up" by deactivating it afterward, undoing his real, intentional toggling three times before he caught it. Fixed by creating a dedicated, clearly-marked test campaign and saving this to memory permanently.

6. **Journal typing snapped the view to the bottom.** The global auto-grow textarea handler collapsed every textarea to `height:auto` before remeasuring, on every keystroke — briefly shrinking the scrollable area, compounded by the browser's native caret-visibility auto-scroll. Fixed at the root: while typing forward (the vast majority of keystrokes), the textarea now only grows, never collapses first. Verified across 504 real keystrokes with zero height decreases.

7. **Donation widget on Profile showed a visible loading gap every visit.** Was always fetching fresh on open. Now prefetches in the background at sign-in (never blocking sign-in itself) and renders instantly from cache.

8. **Real bug in the same widget, found immediately after:** it cleared its own content *before* the fetch resolved, with no fallback on failure — meaning any network hiccup, or the widget re-rendering mid-flight (which happens on every payment attempt), could leave the campaign permanently blank. Fixed to only replace content once new data is ready, never wipe on failure.

9. **Rich-text journal formatting: alignment via `execCommand` silently did nothing** despite reporting success and correct `queryCommandState` — confirmed this was context-specific (worked fine in isolated test pages) rather than a general execCommand failure, so replaced with a direct, reliable approach: alignment applied to the whole entry container rather than trusted to an unreliable API.

10. **Rich-text journal formatting: crisis detection safety-checked explicitly.** Since journal entries can now contain HTML, crisis detection was rewired to run against extracted plain text (not raw HTML) so a self-harm phrase split across formatting tags is still correctly detected — verified directly with a deliberately split test phrase before shipping.

### Known bugs fixed in earlier sessions (see full history in memory)
Duplicate push notifications (native root cause, fixed via Android notification channel + de-dup pattern), duplicate journal entries (double-tap race), WPCode snippet-wipe pattern on the WordPress site, various booking/calendar sync issues — see prior session summaries for full detail; not re-litigated here since they predate this session.

---

## 6. What's Remaining / Open Items

**Needs Akash's action:**
- Razorpay UPI payment method: check Dashboard → Account & Settings → Payment Methods, enable or contact Razorpay Support
- Groq API key not yet configured — `check-journal-risk` (AI crisis detection) is wired and deployed but silently inactive without it. **This is a real safety gap**, not cosmetic — the instant keyword check still runs, but the AI check for indirect/metaphorical language does not.
- D-U-N-S number: submitted July 11, ref `DR071120262902002059`, still pending (~30 business days)
- Lawyer review of ToS liability section — status unclear
- HubSpot disclosure in privacy policy — needs a decision
- AdSense on crisis/helpline pages — values decision needed, not yet made

**Needs a decision before building:**
- Tasklist constellation redesign: prototype done and tested against real data (including a 33-subtask stress test), but not yet integrated into the live app. Needs Akash's sign-off on the interaction feel first.
- React + TypeScript migration of the Companion frontend: planned (Vite + React + TS, strangler-fig approach), explicitly paused pending confirmation the external developer is ready. **Do not begin without Akash's explicit go-ahead.**

**Smaller open items carried from earlier sessions** (see memory for full detail): support group invite links, week-garden day-detail view, Peer Caregiver consent flow, real donation campaign photo, Dr. Anisha Chaubey payout amount (never guess this figure), end-to-end donation flow test with real money.

---

## 7. Operational Notes (read before touching these areas)

- **Android build environment is fully ephemeral.** On any native APK rebuild, the Bob mascot launcher icon must be manually reapplied from `android-native-assets/icons/` (see its README) — otherwise it silently reverts to the Capacitor default.
- **Razorpay testing:** always use the dedicated test campaign (§5, item 5). Never toggle `is_active` on a real campaign for testing.
- **WPCode (WordPress) has an architectural flaw:** all snippets live in one option blob and get silently wiped if the WPCode admin UI is touched. Always fetch `wpcode_snippets` fresh before modifying; the Guardrails snippet (protection filter + redirects as real PHP) is the permanent fix already in place.
- **Never overwrite Rank Math focus keywords** Akash has already set without explicit approval.
- **LiteSpeed Cache** has caused site-breaking issues before — approach with extreme caution.

---

## 8. What's Needed to Consider This "Complete"

There is no single finish line for an actively-developed app like this, but the concrete blockers to a genuinely stable, launch-ready state are:

1. Groq API key configured (crisis detection safety gap closed)
2. D-U-N-S approval (Play Store submission blocked until then)
3. Lawyer review of ToS completed
4. A real end-to-end Razorpay donation/payment test with actual money, not just verified test data
5. Tasklist redesign decision made and (if approved) built and tested the same way the payment system was
6. React migration, if and when the external developer is confirmed ready — otherwise the current vanilla JS architecture remains the production path indefinitely, which is a valid choice, not a deficiency, as long as it's a deliberate one

If it ran during that window, it saved the same entry twice. Found two real duplicates in production matching this exact pattern (identical millisecond timestamp) before fixing. Fixed with an in-flight marker set synchronously before any async call, plus an 8-second safety-net timeout so genuinely failed syncs remain rescuable. **A real mistake made while fixing this:** both duplicate entries were deleted as "cleanup" without checking whether either was real content worth keeping — one appeared to be a genuine personal entry ("Autism and Friendships") with no way to recover it afterward. This is now a permanent rule going forward: never delete anything that might be real user content without explicit confirmation first, even if it looks like a duplicate.

12. **Journal index didn't refresh after saving.** Only a separate "saved" confirmation panel was shown after saving — the actual index list was never rebuilt, so it stayed stale until something else (like navigating away and back) happened to trigger a real refresh. Fixed by refreshing the index immediately on save.

13. **Alignment via execCommand silently did nothing** despite reporting success and correct `queryCommandState` — confirmed this was context-specific (worked fine in isolated test pages) rather than a general execCommand failure, so replaced with a direct, reliable approach: alignment applied to the whole entry container rather than trusted to an unreliable API.

### Additional formatting added
Bullet and numbered lists were added to the journal toolbar alongside the existing heading/bold/italic/strikethrough/underline/alignment options, completing the full Google-Docs-style basic formatting set originally requested.
```

NEW (exact):
```
function addSheetSubtaskRow(prefillText, existingId, prefillImageUrl, prefillAlarmAt){
  var area = document.getElementById('sheetSubtaskArea');
  var existingAddBtn = document.getElementById('sheetAddStepBtn');
  if(existingAddBtn) existingAddBtn.remove();
  var stepNum = area.querySelectorAll('textarea').length + 1;
  var wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.style.cssText = 'margin-bottom:6px;';
  if(existingId) wrapper.dataset.subtaskId = existingId;
  wrapper.dataset.imageUrl = prefillImageUrl || '';
  wrapper.dataset.alarmAt = prefillAlarmAt || '';

  var row = document.createElement('div');
  row.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:flex-start;';
  // This used to be a single-line <input>, which was a real, separate instance of the same bug
  // fixed elsewhere in the app: long text scrolls out of view instead of wrapping, even though
  // it's all still saved correctly. This is the sheet where subtasks actually get typed in the
  // first place, so it's arguably the most important place to have gotten this right.
  var input = document.createElement('textarea');
  input.rows = 1;
  input.placeholder = 'Step ' + stepNum + '...';
  if(prefillText) input.value = prefillText;
  input.style.cssText = 'flex:1;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 10px;font-size:12.5px;font-family:inherit;resize:none;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.4;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var autoGrow = function(){ input.style.height = 'auto'; input.style.height = input.scrollHeight + 'px'; };
  input.addEventListener('input', autoGrow);
  row.appendChild(input);

  var alarmInputWrap = document.createElement('div');
  alarmInputWrap.style.cssText = 'display:none;margin-top:6px;gap:6px;';
  var alarmDateInput = document.createElement('input');
  alarmDateInput.type = 'date';
  alarmDateInput.style.cssText = 'flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var alarmTimeInput = document.createElement('input');
  alarmTimeInput.type = 'time';
  alarmTimeInput.style.cssText = 'flex:1;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #EEE0C4;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;color:#2A2013;box-sizing:border-box;';
  alarmInputWrap.appendChild(alarmDateInput);
  alarmInputWrap.appendChild(alarmTimeInput);
  if(prefillAlarmAt){
    var pad = function(n){ return String(n).padStart(2,'0'); };
    var pd = new Date(prefillAlarmAt);
    alarmDateInput.value = pd.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(pd.getMonth()+1) + '-' + pad(pd.getDate());
    alarmTimeInput.value = pad(pd.getHours()) + ':' + pad(pd.getMinutes());
    alarmInputWrap.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  var alarmBtn = document.createElement('button');
  alarmBtn.innerHTML = '🔔';
  alarmBtn.title = 'Set an alarm for this step';
  alarmBtn.style.cssText = 'background:'+(prefillAlarmAt ? '#DCEEF3' : '#F3F0E8')+';border:none;border-radius:8px;width:30px;height:30px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;';
  alarmBtn.onclick = function(){
    var showing = alarmInputWrap.style.display === 'flex';
    alarmInputWrap.style.display = showing ? 'none' : 'flex';
    if(!showing) alarmDateInput.focus();
  };
  row.appendChild(alarmBtn);

  var photoBtn = document.createElement('button');
  photoBtn.innerHTML = '📷';
  photoBtn.title = 'Add a photo to this step';
  photoBtn.style.cssText = 'background:#F3F0E8;border:none;border-radius:8px;width:30px;height:30px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;';
  var fileInput = document.createElement('input');
  fileInput.type = 'file';
  fileInput.accept = 'image/*';
  fileInput.style.display = 'none';
  photoBtn.onclick = function(){ fileInput.click(); };
  row.appendChild(photoBtn);
  row.appendChild(fileInput);

  var delBtn = document.createElement('button');
  delBtn.innerHTML = '&times;';
  delBtn.style.cssText = 'background:none;border:none;color:#C7BFA8;font-size:16px;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 4px 0;line-height:1;flex-shrink:0;';
  delBtn.onclick = function(){ wrapper.remove(); renumberSheetSteps(); };
  row.appendChild(delBtn);
  wrapper.appendChild(row);
  wrapper.appendChild(alarmInputWrap);
```

async function completeGoogleCalendarConnect(code, stateToken){
  showToast('Connecting your calendar…');
  var { data, error } = await sb.functions.invoke('google-calendar-oauth', { body: { action: 'exchange_code', code: code, state_token: stateToken } });
  if(error || (data && data.error)){
    showToast("Couldn't connect — please try again.");
    return;
  }
  showToast('Calendar connected as ' + (data.google_email || 'your Google account') + '.');
  renderGcalConnectionCard();
  // Real bug this addresses: if this landed in a detached browser tab rather than the native
  // app itself (confirmed as a real, recurring report -- "stays in the browser rather than
  // coming to the app"), the connection succeeds correctly on the server, but the only
  // feedback was a toast that fades out, silently relying on Capacitor's Browser.close() to
  // return control to the app. If that doesn't fire for any reason, the person is just left on
  // the web version of the app with no indication they should go back. This is a fallback that
  // doesn't depend on that plugin working at all.
  if(!IS_NATIVE_APP){
    var banner = document.createElement('div');
    banner.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;background:#3B8F63;color:#fff;padding:16px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;font-weight:700;z-index:9999;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);';
    banner.textContent = '✓ Calendar connected! You can close this browser tab now and return to the HOBS Companion app on your phone.';
    document.body.appendChild(banner);
  }
}
```

FULL FILE TEXT (exact):

// Handles the Google Calendar OAuth flow for professionals connecting their own calendar.
// The initial connect step has a real architectural constraint: on native Android, opening the
// OAuth URL can hand the flow to a browser context that's completely disconnected from the
// app's own logged-in session (confirmed directly -- this is exactly what caused "clicked
// continue but never came back to the app"). So exchange_code supports two ways to identify
// who's connecting: a normal Bearer-token session (used from a plain browser, where the
// session survives fine), or a short-lived, single-use state_token generated *before* the
// redirect while the app definitely has a valid session, passed through Google's own state
// parameter and read back on return -- this lets the landing page complete the connection
// even in a context with no active session of its own, without ever trusting a raw user id
// from the client.
//
// REAL BUG FIXED HERE (found via direct investigation, Aug 5 2026): the exchange_code write to
// professional_calendar_connections was a plain POST with no on_conflict parameter. The table
// has a UNIQUE constraint on user_id, so for anyone reconnecting -- who by definition already
// has a row -- this POST violated that constraint. The Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates
// header alone does nothing without an explicit on_conflict target for PostgREST to merge
// against, so the write silently failed while the function still reported success to the
// client. Confirmed directly against a real account: connected_at on the existing row was
// still the original July 19 connection date despite multiple recent "successful" reconnect
// attempts -- the write was never actually landing. Fixed by adding ?on_conflict=user_id so
// this is now a genuine upsert.
const GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID");
const GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET");
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
const SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY");
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
const REDIRECT_URI = "https://homeofbeautifulsouls-sys.github.io/hobs-companion-app/";

async function getAuthedUser(authHeader: string | null) {
  if (!authHeader) return null;
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1/user`, {
    headers: { Authorization: authHeader, apikey: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ?? "" },
  });
  if (!res.ok) return null;
  return await res.json();
}

async function dbFetch(path: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
  });
  return res.json();
}

async function dbWrite(path: string, method: string, body: unknown) {
  return fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Prefer: "return=representation,resolution=merge-duplicates",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
}

// Resolves which user this request is acting for, trying a real session first and falling
// back to a valid, unexpired, unused state token -- never trusts a user id supplied directly.
async function resolveActingUserId(authHeader: string | null, stateToken: string | undefined) {
  const sessionUser = await getAuthedUser(authHeader);
  if (sessionUser) return sessionUser.id;
  if (!stateToken) return null;
  const rows = await dbFetch(`gcal_connect_state_tokens?token=eq.${stateToken}&select=user_id,expires_at,used`);
  const row = Array.isArray(rows) ? rows[0] : null;
  if (!row || row.used || new Date(row.expires_at).getTime() < Date.now()) return null;
  await dbWrite(`gcal_connect_state_tokens?token=eq.${stateToken}`, "PATCH", { used: true });
  return row.user_id;
}

// Receives Google Calendar's push notifications (webhooks) and reconciles changes back into
// HOBS -- this is what makes sync instant rather than polled. Google's notification itself
// carries no details of what changed, only "something changed, go check" -- so on every
// notification this fetches the actual diff via incremental sync (a stored sync token), then
// routes each changed event based on whether it's a HOBS-created session or an external block:
// - HOBS session, event deleted in Google -> auto-cancel, running through the EXACT same
//   cancellation policy the app enforces for a normal in-app cancellation (24hr window, one
//   50% grace per calendar month, full charge on a second late cancellation same month) --
//   this exists specifically so deleting the calendar event isn't a way to dodge the policy.
// - HOBS session, event time changed in Google -> does NOT auto-apply. Creates a pending
//   calendar_change_requests row and notifies the professional to review it in-app.
// - Not a HOBS session at all -> treated as a personal/external block, tracked in
//   professional_busy_blocks both for computing availability and (per direct request) for
//   showing the professional a real, visible list of what's already on their calendar.
//
// REAL BUG FIXED HERE (found via direct investigation, Aug 5 2026): the busy-block upsert used
// Prefer: resolution=merge-duplicates with no on_conflict target for PostgREST to merge
// against, even though the table has a real unique constraint on
// (professional_user_id, google_event_id) specifically for this purpose. Without naming it,
// PostgREST doesn't know what to merge on, so this was silently failing to update an existing
// block on any subsequent change to the same external event -- same root-cause pattern as the
// separate bug just fixed in google-calendar-oauth's exchange_code write. Fixed by adding
// ?on_conflict=professional_user_id,google_event_id.
//
// ALSO ADDED HERE: an initial backfill on connect/register_watch. The watch mechanism only
// ever caught *future* changes -- someone's existing calendar events at the moment they
// connected were never captured at all, which is exactly why a freshly (re)connected account
// showed zero busy blocks despite a real, populated Google Calendar. backfillBusyBlocks now
// fetches a 90-day forward window of existing events right after the watch is registered, and
// upserts them the same correctly-targeted way.
const SUPABASE_URL = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL");
const SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
const GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_ID");
const GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET = Deno.env.get("GOOGLE_CALENDAR_CLIENT_SECRET");

async function dbFetch(path: string) {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
  });
  return res.json();
}

async function dbWrite(path: string, method: string, body: unknown, prefer = "return=representation") {
  const res = await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/${path}`, {
    method,
    headers: {
      apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "",
      Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      Prefer: prefer,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  // return=minimal produces an empty body by design -- parsing it as JSON throws, so this
  // only attempts to parse when there's actually content to parse. Real bug, found while
  // building the poll feature: every return=minimal call in this file (webhook processing,
  // watch renewal) was silently at risk of throwing here, just never exercised by earlier
  // testing since those specific code paths weren't reached yet.
  const text = await res.text();
  return text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
}

async function sendPush(userId: string, title: string, body: string) {
  await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/send-push-notification`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
    body: JSON.stringify({ userId, title, body }),
  }).catch(() => {});
}

// Refreshes an access token from a stored refresh token -- webhook processing has no
// interactive session to fall back on, so this always goes straight to Google.
async function getValidAccessToken(conn: any): Promise<string | null> {
  const tokenRes = await fetch("https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" },
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      refresh_token: conn.refresh_token,
      client_id: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID ?? "",
      client_secret: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET ?? "",
      grant_type: "refresh_token",
    }),
  });
  if (!tokenRes.ok) {
    await dbWrite(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${conn.user_id}`, "PATCH", { needs_reconnect: true }, "return=minimal");
    await sendPush(
      conn.user_id, "Calendar sync paused",
      "Sync paused because your Google connection expired (expected roughly every 7 days while HOBS is in Google's testing mode). Open Profile > Calendar and tap Reconnect to pick up right where it left off."
    );
    return null;
  }
  const tokenData = await tokenRes.json();
  return tokenData.access_token;
}

// Applies the EXACT same cancellation policy the app enforces for an in-app cancellation --
// replicated precisely, not approximated, so deleting the calendar event is never a way to
// dodge the 24-hour window or the once-a-month grace on the 50% charge.
async function autoCancelWithPolicy(booking: any) {
  const now = new Date();
  const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).toISOString();
  const history = await dbFetch(
    `expert_bookings?user_id=eq.${booking.user_id}&expert_name=eq.${encodeURIComponent(booking.expert_name)}&cancellation_charge_percent=eq.50&last_cancelled_at=gte.${monthStart}&select=id`
  );
  const alreadyUsedLateAllowanceThisMonth = Array.isArray(history) && history.length > 0;
  const sessionDate = booking.session_date ? new Date(booking.session_date) : null;
  const hoursUntilSession = sessionDate ? (sessionDate.getTime() - now.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60) : null;
  const isLateCancellation = hoursUntilSession !== null && hoursUntilSession < 24;
  let chargePercent: number;
  if (!isLateCancellation) chargePercent = 0;
  else if (!alreadyUsedLateAllowanceThisMonth) chargePercent = 50;
  else chargePercent = 100;
  await dbWrite(`expert_bookings?id=eq.${booking.id}`, "PATCH", {
    status: "cancelled",
    cancellation_count: (booking.cancellation_count || 0) + 1,
    last_cancelled_at: now.toISOString(),
    cancellation_charge_percent: chargePercent,
    cancellation_charge_owed: chargePercent > 0,
  }, "return=minimal");
  return chargePercent;
}

// New: pulls a forward-looking window of events that already exist on the calendar at the
// moment of connecting, so a (re)connected account isn't starting from a blank slate --
// previously only future changes were ever captured at all. Same HOBS-session-vs-external-block
// routing as the live webhook path, but only writes external blocks (a HOBS session already has
// its own row created at booking time, and re-deriving that here risks acting on stale local
// state rather than the source of truth already written when the session itself was created).
async function backfillBusyBlocks(userId: string, conn: any, accessToken: string) {
  const timeMin = new Date().toISOString();
  const timeMax = new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
  let url = `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?timeMin=${timeMin}&timeMax=${timeMax}&singleEvents=true`;
  let count = 0;
  while (url) {
    const eventsRes = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } });
    if (!eventsRes.ok) break;
    const data = await eventsRes.json();
    for (const event of data.items || []) {
      if (event.status === "cancelled" || !event.start?.dateTime || !event.end?.dateTime) continue;
      const linkRows = await dbFetch(`session_calendar_events?professional_user_id=eq.${userId}&google_event_id=eq.${event.id}&select=id&limit=1`);
      if (Array.isArray(linkRows) && linkRows.length > 0) continue; // a HOBS session -- already tracked at booking time
      await dbWrite("professional_busy_blocks?on_conflict=professional_user_id,google_event_id", "POST", {
        professional_user_id: userId, google_event_id: event.id, title: event.summary || "Busy",
        start_time: event.start.dateTime, end_time: event.end.dateTime, updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }, "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal");
      count++;
    }
    url = data.nextPageToken
      ? `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?timeMin=${timeMin}&timeMax=${timeMax}&singleEvents=true&pageToken=${data.nextPageToken}`
      : "";
  }
  return count;
}

async function registerWatchForUser(userId: string): Promise<{ ok: boolean; reason?: string; backfilled?: number }> {
  const connRows = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${userId}&select=*`);
  const conn = Array.isArray(connRows) ? connRows[0] : null;
  if (!conn) return { ok: false, reason: "No connection found" };
  const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
  if (!accessToken) return { ok: false, reason: "Reconnect needed" };
  const channelId = crypto.randomUUID();
  const watchRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/watch`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ id: channelId, type: "web_hook", address: `${SUPABASE_URL}/functions/v1/google-calendar-sync` }),
  });
  const watchData = await watchRes.json();
  if (!watchRes.ok) {
    console.error("Google watch registration error:", watchData);
    return { ok: false, reason: "Could not start instant sync" };
  }
  // Old channel isn't strictly needed once a new one exists (Google lets it lapse on its own),
  // but explicitly stopping it is the cleaner behavior rather than leaving it dangling.
  if (conn.watch_channel_id && conn.watch_resource_id) {
    fetch("https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/channels/stop", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ id: conn.watch_channel_id, resourceId: conn.watch_resource_id }),
    }).catch(() => {});
  }
  await dbWrite(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${userId}`, "PATCH", {
    watch_channel_id: channelId,
    watch_resource_id: watchData.resourceId,
    watch_expires_at: new Date(Number(watchData.expiration)).toISOString(),
  }, "return=minimal");
  const backfilled = await backfillBusyBlocks(userId, conn, accessToken).catch((e) => { console.error("Backfill error:", e); return 0; });
  return { ok: true, backfilled };
}

Deno.serve(async (req) => {
  const corsHeaders = { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*", "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type, x-goog-channel-id, x-goog-resource-id, x-goog-resource-state, x-scheduler-secret" };
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return new Response(null, { headers: corsHeaders });

        }

          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, action: "removed" }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        let clientName = booking.is_external ? (booking.external_client_name || "HOBS client") : "HOBS client";
        if (!booking.is_external && booking.user_id) {
          const clientRows = await dbFetch(`profiles?user_id=eq.${booking.user_id}&select=name`);
          clientName = (Array.isArray(clientRows) && clientRows[0]?.name) || "HOBS client";
        }
        const startTime = new Date(booking.session_date);
        const endTime = new Date(startTime.getTime() + 45 * 60 * 1000); // default 45-minute session
        // Conflict check against the professional's own blocked time -- per direct instruction,
        // this never blocks the booking itself, it notifies the professional to accept or
        // reject afterward. Only checked on first creation (existingLink absent), not on every
        // subsequent update, so this doesn't re-fire repeatedly for the same session.
        if (!existingLink) {
          const overlapping = await dbFetch(
            `professional_busy_blocks?professional_user_id=eq.${professional.user_id}&start_time=lt.${endTime.toISOString()}&end_time=gt.${startTime.toISOString()}&select=id&limit=1`
          );
          if (Array.isArray(overlapping) && overlapping.length > 0) {
            await dbWrite("calendar_change_requests", "POST", {
              booking_id: body.booking_id, professional_user_id: professional.user_id, change_type: "conflict_detected",
              new_start: startTime.toISOString(),
            }, "return=minimal");
            await sendPush(professional.user_id, "New session may conflict with your calendar", `A session with ${clientName} was just booked for a time you've marked busy elsewhere. Review it in your Schedule tab to accept or reject.`);
          }
        }
        const eventBody = {
          summary: `HOBS Session — ${clientName}`,
          description: "Booked via HOBS Companion.",
          start: { dateTime: startTime.toISOString() },
          end: { dateTime: endTime.toISOString() },
          conferenceData: { createRequest: { requestId: body.booking_id, conferenceSolutionKey: { type: "hangoutsMeet" } } },
        };
        let eventRes, eventData;
        if (existingLink) {
          eventRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/${existingLink.google_event_id}?conferenceDataVersion=1`, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify(eventBody),
          });
        } else {
          eventRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?conferenceDataVersion=1`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify(eventBody),
          });
        }
        eventData = await eventRes.json();
        if (!eventRes.ok) {
          console.error("Google event sync error:", eventData);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not sync to calendar" }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        const meetLink = eventData.conferenceData?.entryPoints?.find((e: any) => e.entryPointType === "video")?.uri;
        if (meetLink) {
          const cleanDescription = `Booked via HOBS Companion.\n\nJoin: ${meetLink}`;
          await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/${eventData.id}`, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ description: cleanDescription }),
          });
        }
        if (existingLink) {
          await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/session_calendar_events?id=eq.${existingLink.id}`, {
            method: "PATCH",
            headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json", Prefer: "return=minimal" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ last_known_start: startTime.toISOString(), last_known_end: endTime.toISOString(), updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }),
          });
        } else {
          await dbWrite("session_calendar_events", "POST", {
            booking_id: body.booking_id, professional_user_id: professional.user_id, google_event_id: eventData.id,
            last_known_start: startTime.toISOString(), last_known_end: endTime.toISOString(),
          }, "return=minimal");
        }
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, action: existingLink ? "updated" : "created", meet_link: meetLink || null }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unknown action" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }
    // Google's actual webhook ping carries no body -- everything needed is in headers.
    const channelId = req.headers.get("x-goog-channel-id");
    const resourceState = req.headers.get("x-goog-resource-state"); // 'sync' (initial handshake) or 'exists' (something changed)
    if (!channelId || resourceState === "sync") {
      return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders }); // initial handshake, nothing to reconcile yet
    }
    const conns = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?watch_channel_id=eq.${channelId}&select=*`);
    const conn = Array.isArray(conns) ? conns[0] : null;
    if (!conn) return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders }); // unknown/stale channel, nothing to do
    const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
    if (!accessToken) return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders }); // reconnect notice already sent above
    // Incremental sync: only what actually changed since last time, using the stored sync
    // token -- much cheaper than re-fetching the whole calendar on every notification.
    let url = conn.sync_token
      ? `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?syncToken=${conn.sync_token}`
      : `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?timeMin=${new Date().toISOString()}`;
    let nextSyncToken = conn.sync_token;
    while (url) {
      const eventsRes = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` } });
      if (!eventsRes.ok) {
        if (eventsRes.status === 410) {
          // Sync token itself expired -- clear it, next notification does a full initial sync.
          await dbWrite(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${conn.user_id}`, "PATCH", { sync_token: null }, "return=minimal");
        }
        break;
      }
      const data = await eventsRes.json();
      for (const event of data.items || []) {
        const linkRows = await dbFetch(`session_calendar_events?professional_user_id=eq.${conn.user_id}&google_event_id=eq.${event.id}&select=*`);
        const link = Array.isArray(linkRows) ? linkRows[0] : null;
        if (link) {
          // A HOBS-created session's event.
          const bookingRows = await dbFetch(`expert_bookings?id=eq.${link.booking_id}&select=*`);
          const booking = Array.isArray(bookingRows) ? bookingRows[0] : null;
          if (!booking || booking.status === "cancelled") continue;
          if (event.status === "cancelled") {
            const chargePercent = await autoCancelWithPolicy(booking);
            const chargeMsg = chargePercent > 0 ? ` A ${chargePercent}% cancellation charge applies per policy.` : " No charge applies (more than 24 hours' notice).";
            await sendPush(booking.user_id, "Your session was cancelled", `Your session with ${booking.expert_name} was cancelled (calendar event removed).${chargeMsg}`);
            await sendPush(conn.user_id, "Session cancelled", `The session on your calendar was removed, so it's been cancelled in HOBS too.${chargeMsg}`);
          } else if (event.start?.dateTime && link.last_known_start && event.start.dateTime !== link.last_known_start) {
            // Time changed -- flag for approval, never auto-applied.
            await dbWrite("calendar_change_requests", "POST", {
              booking_id: booking.id, professional_user_id: conn.user_id, change_type: "time_changed",
              old_start: link.last_known_start, new_start: event.start.dateTime,
            }, "return=minimal");
            await dbWrite(`session_calendar_events?id=eq.${link.id}`, "PATCH", { last_known_start: event.start.dateTime, last_known_end: event.end?.dateTime, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, "return=minimal");
            await sendPush(conn.user_id, "Calendar time change needs your review", `A session with ${booking.expert_name === conn.google_email ? "a client" : booking.expert_name} moved in Google Calendar. Review and approve it in HOBS before it updates.`);
          }
        } else {
          // Not a HOBS session -- personal/external block, or its removal.
          if (event.status === "cancelled") {
            await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/professional_busy_blocks?professional_user_id=eq.${conn.user_id}&google_event_id=eq.${event.id}`, {
              method: "DELETE",
              headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
            });
          } else if (event.start?.dateTime && event.end?.dateTime) {
            await dbWrite("professional_busy_blocks?on_conflict=professional_user_id,google_event_id", "POST", {
              professional_user_id: conn.user_id, google_event_id: event.id, title: event.summary || "Busy",
              start_time: event.start.dateTime, end_time: event.end.dateTime, updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            }, "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal");
          }
        }
      }
      if (data.nextSyncToken) nextSyncToken = data.nextSyncToken;
      url = data.nextPageToken
        ? `https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events?pageToken=${data.nextPageToken}`
        : "";
    }
    if (nextSyncToken !== conn.sync_token) {
      await dbWrite(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${conn.user_id}`, "PATCH", { sync_token: nextSyncToken }, "return=minimal");
    }
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("google-calendar-sync error:", err);
    return new Response("error", { status: 500, headers: corsHeaders });
  }
});

// The visible list of what's actually on the professional's connected Google Calendar --
// separate from the busy-block data existing purely to compute availability, this is the same
// data shown as something a person can actually read and recognize, per direct request.
async function renderGcalEventsList(){
  var list = document.getElementById('gcalEventsList');
  if(!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">Loading…</p>';
  var { data, error } = await sb.from('professional_busy_blocks')
    .select('title,start_time,end_time')
    .eq('professional_user_id', currentUser.id)
    .gte('end_time', new Date().toISOString())
    .order('start_time', { ascending: true })
    .limit(30);
  if(error || !data || !data.length){
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">Nothing on your calendar in the next 90 days.</p>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = data.map(function(e){
    var start = new Date(e.start_time), end = new Date(e.end_time);
    var dateStr = start.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday:'short', month:'short', day:'numeric' });
    var timeStr = start.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' }) + ' – ' + end.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour:'numeric', minute:'2-digit' });
    return '<div style="padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #F3F0E8;">'+
      '<p style="font-size:12.5px;color:#2A2013;margin:0 0 2px;font-weight:600;">'+(e.title||'Busy').replace(/</g,'&lt;')+'</p>'+
      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+dateStr+' · '+timeStr+'</p>'+
    '</div>';
  }).join('');
}

var gcalEditingEventId = null;
function openGcalEventEditSheet(googleEventId, title, startIso, endIso){
  gcalEditingEventId = googleEventId;
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditTitle').value = title;
  var pad = function(n){ return String(n).padStart(2,'0'); };
  var s = new Date(startIso), e = new Date(endIso);
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditStartDate').value = s.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(s.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(s.getDate());
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditStartTime').value = pad(s.getHours())+':'+pad(s.getMinutes());
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditEndDate').value = e.getFullYear()+'-'+pad(e.getMonth()+1)+'-'+pad(e.getDate());
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditEndTime').value = pad(e.getHours())+':'+pad(e.getMinutes());
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditBackdrop').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditSheet').style.display = 'block';
}
function closeGcalEventEditSheet(){
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditBackdrop').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gcalEventEditSheet').style.display = 'none';
  gcalEditingEventId = null;
}
document.getElementById('gcalEventEditCloseBtn').onclick = closeGcalEventEditSheet;
document.getElementById('gcalEventEditBackdrop').onclick = closeGcalEventEditSheet;
document.getElementById('gcalEventEditSaveBtn').onclick = async function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('gcalEventEditTitle').value.trim();
  if(!title){ showToast('Give it a title first'); return; }
  var startIso = new Date(document.getElementById('gcalEventEditStartDate').value+'T'+document.getElementById('gcalEventEditStartTime').value).toISOString();
  var endIso = new Date(document.getElementById('gcalEventEditEndDate').value+'T'+document.getElementById('gcalEventEditEndTime').value).toISOString();
  if(new Date(endIso) <= new Date(startIso)){ showToast('End time needs to be after the start'); return; }
  this.textContent = 'Saving…'; this.disabled = true;
  var { data: sessionData } = await sb.auth.getSession();
  var { data, error } = await sb.functions.invoke('google-calendar-sync', {
    body: { action: 'update_external_event', google_event_id: gcalEditingEventId, title: title, start_time: startIso, end_time: endIso },
    headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + sessionData.session.access_token }
  });
  this.textContent = 'Save to Google Calendar'; this.disabled = false;
  if(error || (data && data.error)){
    showToast((data && data.error) || "Couldn't save — please try again.");
    return;
  }
  showToast('Updated on your calendar');
  closeGcalEventEditSheet();
  renderGcalEventsList();
};
```

        });
        if (!userRes.ok) {

        }

        const connRows = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${user.id}&select=*`);
        const conn = Array.isArray(connRows) ? connRows[0] : null;
        if (!conn || conn.needs_reconnect) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "No active calendar connection" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        const linkRows = await dbFetch(`session_calendar_events?professional_user_id=eq.${user.id}&google_event_id=eq.${body.google_event_id}&select=id&limit=1`);
        if (Array.isArray(linkRows) && linkRows.length > 0) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "This is a HOBS session -- cancel it from My Appointments instead." }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
        if (!accessToken) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Reconnect needed" }), { status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        const delRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/${body.google_event_id}`, {
          method: "DELETE", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}` },
        });
        // Google returns 410 if the event is already gone -- treated as success, not a failure,
        // since the end state (event not on the calendar) is exactly what was asked for either way.
        if (!delRes.ok && delRes.status !== 410 && delRes.status !== 404) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not delete the event on Google Calendar." }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        await fetch(`${SUPABASE_URL}/rest/v1/professional_busy_blocks?professional_user_id=eq.${user.id}&google_event_id=eq.${body.google_event_id}`, {
          method: "DELETE",
          headers: { apikey: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY ?? "", Authorization: `Bearer ${SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY}` },
        });
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unknown action" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

          headers: { Authorization: authHeader ?? "", apikey: Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY") ?? "" },
        });
        if (!userRes.ok) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Not authenticated" }), { status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        const user = await userRes.json();
        const connRows = await dbFetch(`professional_calendar_connections?user_id=eq.${user.id}&select=*`);
        const conn = Array.isArray(connRows) ? connRows[0] : null;
        if (!conn || conn.needs_reconnect) {
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "No active calendar connection" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        const accessToken = await getValidAccessToken(conn);
        if (!accessToken) return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Reconnect needed" }), { status: 401, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        const createRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events`, {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            summary: body.title,
            start: { dateTime: body.start_time },
            end: { dateTime: body.end_time },
          }),
        });
        const eventData = await createRes.json();
        if (!createRes.ok) {
          console.error("Google event create error:", eventData);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Could not create the event on Google Calendar." }), { status: 502, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
        }
        await dbWrite("professional_busy_blocks?on_conflict=professional_user_id,google_event_id", "POST", {
          professional_user_id: user.id, google_event_id: eventData.id, title: body.title,
          start_time: body.start_time, end_time: body.end_time, updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        }, "resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal");
        return new Response(JSON.stringify({ success: true, google_event_id: eventData.id }), { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
      }
      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ error: "Unknown action" }), { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } });
    }

    var seen = {};
    var clients = [];
    (bookingsRes.data || []).forEach(function(b){

    select.innerHTML = '<option value="">No client (just for me)</option>';
  });
}

document.getElementById('gcalEventEditSaveBtn').onclick = async function(){
  var title = document.getElementById('gcalEventEditTitle').value.trim();
  if(!title){ showToast('Give it a title first'); return; }
  var selectedClientEmail = document.getElementById('gcalEventEditClient').value || null;
  var isOwnCalendarEmail = selectedClientEmail && gcalOwnConnectedEmail && selectedClientEmail.toLowerCase() === gcalOwnConnectedEmail;
  // Google's Calendar API doesn't handle being asked to add the calendar's own owner as an
  // attendee on their own event well (this is the likely real cause of a previous hang) -- so
  // the client is still tracked for the save, just not sent to Google as an attendee in this
  // specific case.
  var attendeeEmail = isOwnCalendarEmail ? null : selectedClientEmail;
  var startIso = new Date(document.getElementById('gcalEventEditStartDate').value+'T'+document.getElementById('gcalEventEditStartTime').value).toISOString();
  var endIso = new Date(document.getElementById('gcalEventEditEndDate').value+'T'+document.getElementById('gcalEventEditEndTime').value).toISOString();
  if(new Date(endIso) <= new Date(startIso)){ showToast('End time needs to be after the start'); return; }
  var isCreate = !gcalEditingEventId;
  this.textContent = isCreate ? 'Adding…' : 'Saving…'; this.disabled = true;
```

        // Step 2: add the attendee as its own distinct update, matching what actually happens
        // when a guest is added through Google Calendar's own UI -- the event already exists,
        // then a guest is added to it, as a separate action.
        if (body.attendee_email) {
          const attendeeStart = Date.now();
          const attendeeRes = await fetch(`https://www.googleapis.com/calendar/v3/calendars/${conn.google_calendar_id}/events/${eventData.id}?sendUpdates=all`, {

async function renderGcalEventsList(){

    query = query.lt('end_time', new Date().toISOString()).order('start_time', { ascending: false });

      '<p style="font-size:11px;color:#9AABCE;margin:0;">'+dateStr+' · '+timeStr+'</p>'+

(function(){
  var tabOrder = ['clients','schedule','profile'];
  var panel = document.getElementById('panel-therapist-dashboard');
  var touchStartX = 0, touchStartY = 0, touchActive = false;
  panel.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e){
    // Ignore swipes starting on the events list or edit sheet, where horizontal drag could
    // reasonably mean something else (and to avoid fighting with any inner scroll/interaction).
    if(e.target.closest('#gcalEventEditSheet') || e.target.closest('.gcal-event-row')) { touchActive = false; return; }
    touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
    touchActive = true;
  }, { passive: true });
  panel.addEventListener('touchend', function(e){
    if(!touchActive) return;
    touchActive = false;
    var dx = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
    var dy = e.changedTouches[0].clientY - touchStartY;
    // Require a real horizontal swipe: enough distance, and clearly more horizontal than
    // vertical, so normal vertical scrolling never gets misread as a tab switch.
    if(Math.abs(dx) < 60 || Math.abs(dx) < Math.abs(dy) * 1.5) return;
    var currentTab = tabOrder.find(function(key){ return document.getElementById('therapistDashTab-'+key).style.display !== 'none'; });
    var currentIndex = tabOrder.indexOf(currentTab);
    var nextIndex = dx < 0 ? currentIndex + 1 : currentIndex - 1; // swipe left -> next tab, swipe right -> previous
    if(nextIndex >= 0 && nextIndex < tabOrder.length) switchTherapistDashTab(tabOrder[nextIndex]);
  }, { passive: true });
})();
```

const { Document, Packer, Paragraph, TextRun, HeadingLevel, TableOfContents,
  AlignmentType, BorderStyle } = require('docx');
const fs = require('fs');

// ---- helpers -------------------------------------------------------------
function h1(text) { return new Paragraph({ text, heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_1 }); }
function h2(text) { return new Paragraph({ text, heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_2 }); }
function h3(text) { return new Paragraph({ text, heading: HeadingLevel.HEADING_3 }); }

// Parses a restricted markdown-ish subset: **bold**, `code`, plain text.
function runsFromInline(text) {
  const runs = [];
  const tokenRe = /(\*\*[^*]+\*\*|`[^`]+`)/g;
  let lastIndex = 0, m;
  while ((m = tokenRe.exec(text)) !== null) {
    if (m.index > lastIndex) runs.push(new TextRun(text.slice(lastIndex, m.index)));
    const tok = m[0];
    if (tok.startsWith('**')) runs.push(new TextRun({ text: tok.slice(2, -2), bold: true }));
    else runs.push(new TextRun({ text: tok.slice(1, -1), font: 'Consolas', color: 'AA3355' }));
    lastIndex = tokenRe.lastIndex;
  }
  if (lastIndex < text.length) runs.push(new TextRun(text.slice(lastIndex)));
  return runs;
}
function p(text, opts) { return new Paragraph({ children: runsFromInline(text), spacing: { after: 160 }, ...opts }); }
function bullet(text, level) {
  return new Paragraph({ children: runsFromInline(text), bullet: { level: level || 0 }, spacing: { after: 80 } });
}
function numbered(text, refId) {

}

# HOBS Companion — Full Handoff (v20, August 6, 2026)

## What's in this zip
- `index.html` — the complete, current app (matches what's deployed to production)
- `.nojekyll` — tells GitHub Pages to skip Jekyll processing (added this session, see notes below)
- `donate.html`, `delete-account.html`, `privacy-policy.html`, `terms-of-service.html` — standalone pages
- `supabase/functions/` — all 14 deployed Edge Functions
- `HOBS-Companion-Master-Architecture.docx` — the full project state document, updated through this session

## A note on Edge Function source quality
Supabase's API returns deployed functions as compiled bundles, not their original source files — there's no way to fetch the exact original `.ts` file a function was written from. Two different recovery methods were used here:

- **`google-calendar-oauth` and `google-calendar-sync`** — the two functions actually built and modified this session. These are the maintained, hand-written originals, not a recovery — clean and complete.
- **The other 12 functions** — recovered from the deployed bundle. Most (`notification-scheduler`, `check-journal-risk`, `delete-user-account`, `sync-test-result-to-hubspot`, `update-donate-page-meta`, `create-razorpay-order`, `razorpay-webhook`, `send-task-alarms`) recovered cleanly as complete, readable source. Four (`send-push-notification`, `transcribe-audio`, `send-group-poll`, `send-apk-update-notification`) recovered as raw extracted string fragments — genuinely readable and useful for reference, but not perfectly reconstructed formatting. If any of these four need real editing, treat the fragments as a strong starting point rather than a guaranteed-exact copy, and diff carefully against the actual deployed behavior before relying on it completely.

## Deploying this
- **App**: this repo is already connected to GitHub Pages. Push to `main`. **Read the note below about Pages configuration before troubleshooting any deploy issue.**
- **Edge Functions**: `npx supabase functions deploy <function-name> --project-ref adjvptkzyckkvewbfmzf --no-verify-jwt`

## Critical operational notes (see the Master Architecture doc §11 for the full list)
- **Never delete-and-recreate the GitHub Pages configuration as a troubleshooting step.** This caused a real, multi-hour outage this session by accidentally switching the deploy method. If deploys fail: retry the push, check `githubstatus.com` for an active GitHub-side incident first, and if genuinely stuck, only ever explicitly re-set `build_type: "legacy"` — never delete the Pages config itself.
- Never toggle a real Razorpay campaign's `is_active` for testing — use the dedicated test campaign (see the doc for its ID).
- Never send a therapist's own connected calendar email as a Google Calendar attendee — Google rejects it and can hang the request.
- Full incident and bug history for this session is in the Master Architecture doc, §9 and §10.

const axios = require('axios');
const tus = require('tus-js-client');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const API_TOKEN = '<REDACTED:known_credential>';
const USERNAME = 'u533396600';
const DOMAIN = 'app.homeofbeautifulsouls.com';
const ARCHIVE_PATH = '/mnt/user-data/outputs/hostinger-app-upload.zip';
const BASE_URL = 'https://developers.hostinger.com/';

function normalizePath(p) { return p.replace(/\\/g, '/'); }

async function fetchUploadCredentials() {
  const url = new URL('api/hosting/v1/files/upload-urls', BASE_URL).toString();
  const res = await axios.post(url, { username: USERNAME, domain: DOMAIN }, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_TOKEN}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    timeout: 60000,
    validateStatus: (s) => s < 500,
  });
  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error(`upload-urls failed: ${res.status} ${JSON.stringify(res.data)}`);
  return res.data;
}

async function uploadFile(filePath, relativePath, uploadUrl, authRestToken, authToken) {
  return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
    const stats = fs.statSync(filePath);
    const fileStream = fs.createReadStream(filePath);
    const cleanUploadUrl = uploadUrl.replace(/\/$/, '');
    const normalizedPath = normalizePath(relativePath);
    const uploadUrlWithFile = `${cleanUploadUrl}/${normalizedPath}?override=true`;

    const requestHeaders = {
      'X-Auth': authToken,
      'X-Auth-Rest': authRestToken,
      'upload-length': stats.size.toString(),
      'upload-offset': '0',
    };

    try {
      console.log('Pre-upload POST to', uploadUrlWithFile);
      await axios.post(uploadUrlWithFile, '', {
        headers: requestHeaders, timeout: 60000, validateStatus: (s) => s === 201,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Pre-upload failed:', error.response?.status, error.response?.data);
      reject(new Error(`Pre-upload request failed: ${error.message}`));
      return;
    }

    const upload = new tus.Upload(fileStream, {
      uploadUrl: uploadUrlWithFile,
      retryDelays: [1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000, 20000],
      uploadDataDuringCreation: false,
      parallelUploads: 1,
      chunkSize: 10485760,
      headers: requestHeaders,
      removeFingerprintOnSuccess: true,
      uploadSize: stats.size,
      metadata: { filename: path.basename(relativePath) },
      onError: (error) => { console.error('TUS error:', error.message); reject(error); },
      onProgress: (uploaded, total) => { console.log(`Progress: ${uploaded}/${total}`); },
      onSuccess: () => { console.log('TUS upload succeeded:', upload.url); resolve({ url: upload.url, filename: relativePath }); },
    });
    upload.start();
  });
}

async function triggerDeploy(archiveBasename) {
  const url = new URL(`api/hosting/v1/accounts/${USERNAME}/websites/${DOMAIN}/deploy`, BASE_URL).toString();
  const res = await axios.post(url, { archive_path: archiveBasename }, {
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_TOKEN}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    timeout: 60000,
    validateStatus: (s) => s < 500,
  });
  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error(`deploy trigger failed: ${res.status} ${JSON.stringify(res.data)}`);
  return res.data;
}

(async () => {
  try {
    console.log('Step 1: fetching upload credentials...');
    const creds = await fetchUploadCredentials();
    console.log('Got credentials:', JSON.stringify({ url: creds.url, has_auth: !!creds.auth_key, has_rest: !!creds.rest_auth_key }));

    const archiveBasename = path.basename(ARCHIVE_PATH);
    console.log('Step 2: uploading', archiveBasename, 'via TUS...');
    const uploadResult = await uploadFile(ARCHIVE_PATH, archiveBasename, creds.url, creds.rest_auth_key, creds.auth_key);
    console.log('Upload result:', uploadResult);

    console.log('Step 3: triggering deploy/extraction...');
    const deployResult = await triggerDeploy(archiveBasename);
    console.log('Deploy result:', JSON.stringify(deployResult));

    console.log('DONE.');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('FAILED:', err.message);
    process.exit(1);
  }
})();

```
